residualTrustLimitation: One parent harness process controls all three child-process launches; this attestation demonstrates local runtime/process separation between seat adapters only, not cryptographic provider non-collusion.
text: {"voteValue":"APPROVE","rationale":"All seven mandates are substantively satisfied. (1) ALLOW_ONCE/consume-once exists only as privileged ledger state; no installed dispatch route, client library symbol, or execution-tier caller, with build/deploy tests enforcing absence and V1D described strictly as a dormant, non-installed interface gated by a separate ADR — no consumption flow is described. (2) stopEpoch is fully specified: authledgerd sole writer, mutation only via mihver-stop-operator on stop-admin.sock, BEGIN IMMEDIATE with guarded WHERE epoch=old and same-transaction audit, synchronous=FULL WAL with pre-socket recovery/integrity/singleton-cardinality checks, fail-closed on ambiguity with no guessing or reset, no decrement/set RPC in either protocol, and issuanceStopEpoch equality checks give stale-grant invalidation. (3) Separation is mechanical: distinct OS identity, four role-scoped admin sockets with distinct groups plus SO_PEERCRED and per-RPC allowlists. (5) No HSM/TPM/quorum theater. (6) Claude/Codex confined to the client group with no FD passing. Defect to fix in implementation, not a trust-boundary reopening and fail-closed: socket dir 0750 root:mihver-ledger blocks traversal by the four admin groups and client group, and a daemon with no supplementary groups cannot chgrp its sockets — use service-manager-created sockets with per-role SocketGroup/SocketMode."}
